source.kind: frontier-labs-monitor SQLite store (first-party ATS boards: Ashby / Greenhouse / Lever / Google Careers)

observation_window.note: observed_at is the employer's posting date; every included posting was still open on verified_open_on.

ai.label: AI
ai.definition: AI-native companies: frontier labs, AI model developers, AI infrastructure & compute, AI hardware & silicon, applied-AI startups, and physical AI & robotics. Membership requires a reviewed cohort at medium or high confidence.

crypto.label: Crypto
crypto.definition: Crypto-native companies. Employer-posted ranges are thin here; Up Top's crypto model bands carry most of this market.

ai_crypto.label: AI × Crypto
ai_crypto.definition: Companies explicitly building AI-native products on crypto rails. Membership is listed per company, never inferred.

frontier_lab.label: Frontier labs
frontier_lab.definition: Labs training general-purpose frontier foundation models.

ai_model_developer.label: AI model developers
ai_model_developer.definition: Companies training their own domain or media models (voice, video, music, image, code, science, world models) that are not general frontier labs.

ai_infrastructure_compute.label: AI infrastructure & compute
ai_infrastructure_compute.definition: GPU clouds and neoclouds, inference and serving platforms, vector databases, agent frameworks, evals and observability, and AI training-data vendors.

ai_hardware_silicon.label: AI hardware & silicon
ai_hardware_silicon.definition: Companies designing AI accelerators and AI-specific compute hardware.

applied_ai.label: Applied-AI startups
applied_ai.definition: AI-native application companies selling an AI product into a vertical or function.

physical_ai_robotics.label: Physical AI & robotics
physical_ai_robotics.definition: Humanoids, robot foundation models, and autonomous vehicles. Boards carry many mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing roles.

crypto.label: Crypto
crypto.definition: Crypto-native protocols, exchanges, market makers, wallets, and tokenization companies.

fintech.label: Fintech
fintech.definition: Financial technology companies that are not AI-native or crypto-native.

health.label: Health
health.definition: Care providers and health-data companies that are not AI-native products.

defense_space.label: Defense & space
defense_space.definition: Defense autonomy and space infrastructure companies.

developer_tools.label: Developer tools & cloud
developer_tools.definition: General developer infrastructure that is not AI-specific.

other.label: Other
other.definition: Reviewed and found outside the AI and crypto markets.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.definition: Not yet verified. Excluded from every market until reviewed.

definitions.evidence_kind: employer_posting — a range the employer published on its own ATS board. No calls, budgets, expectations, offers, or surveys are in this release.
definitions.component: base_salary as posted. Bonus, commission/OTE, sign-on, equity, and token value are not in these numbers; equity_offered is the board's boolean only.
definitions.component_confidence: medium on Sales/BD and Solutions families because a posted band there may be an on-target figure the source does not label.
definitions.posted_low: percentiles of the LOWER bound of posted ranges (USD, annual, full-time-eligible rows).
definitions.posted_high: percentiles of the UPPER bound of posted ranges. p50 here is the median advertised ceiling — not median pay.
definitions.posted_midpoint: percentiles of (low + high) / 2 per posting — 'posted range midpoint', never 'median salary'.
definitions.company_balanced_midpoint_p50: median of per-company median midpoints; compare with posted_midpoint.p50 to see whether large boards dominate.
definitions.employer_hhi: Herfindahl index of eligible postings by employer, 0–10000; higher means fewer employers define the cohort.
definitions.meets_display_rule: true only when usd_annual_eligible >= 20 and eligible_employers >= 5 — a product heuristic, not a statistical guarantee.
definitions.level: parsed from the title only; 'unspecified' means the employer did not state a level.
definitions.funding_stage: always null in this release — no dated funding evidence is attached to boards; never inferred from a name.

privacy.statement: This exporter reads only the ATS-derived store and static config. Recruiter calls, candidate expectations, client budgets, offers, and accepted packages have no path into this artifact.
